summary: Quest-ready alerts, optional automatic accept and turn-in, a current-zone filter, party progress and reward sell prices.
description: Forever Quests plays a sound and prints a message when a quest becomes ready to turn in or an objective is finished. It can accept and turn in quests for you (both off by default; hold Shift to skip it once), and it never picks a reward when a quest offers a choice. It can show only the quests of your current zone, in the quest log and in the tracker. It shows the vendor sell price of each reward choice, and shares objective progress with party members who also use it. It also counts the quests, experience and money you earn from turn-ins. Change the settings in the game's Options window or type /fq.
